summary: Frontend-only regression after the proxy-gzip P0 login fix. UI login flow now succeeds end-to-end (email step -> password step -> /dashboard). All refactored screens using useApiSWR (system-status, help-support list + [slug], settings, storefront) render without runtime crash, red overlay, or infinite spinner. Wave-1 regression screens (/referrals, /profile, /dashboard, /customers, /invoices, /notifications) all load cleanly with 0 page errors and 0 console errors captured.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a help-article card (data-testid=help-article-card-0) via Playwright click/mouse.click does not navigate to /help-support/<slug>. router.push is wired in onClick on the Box, but the click doesn't fire routing in this environment (URL stayed at /help-support). Direct navigation to /help-support/<slug> works and renders correctly (article body or graceful 'Article not found'). May be a click-target/pointer-events issue on the outer Box, or event bubbling being swallowed by an inner element.

action_items: Investigate why the outer Box onClick=router.push on help-article-card-N does not fire in the preview environment. Consider wrapping the card content in a real <Link>/<a href> (Next Link) so it works with keyboard, right-click 'open in new tab', and Playwright clicks; current cursor:pointer Box is not accessible/discoverable as a link.
critical_code_review_comments: pages/settings/index.tsx: DisplayCurrencySelector and UserDisplayCurrencySelector only render when showDisplayCurrency && selectedId. The test user has no company (selectedId undefined) so these selectors were never rendered. This is expected per the review note (empty state), NOT a bug — but it means the refactor of these two selectors was NOT exercised in-DOM during this run. Consider seeding at least one company for the test merchant so future regression runs can actually assert the refactored selectors.
Help articles are rendered as Box with onClick=router.push. Prefer semantic <Link href="/help-support/[slug]"> for a11y, SEO, and reliable navigation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for login + render-without-crash checks; help article click-through 0/1 (direct URL navigation works)

context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 login fix (proxy accept-encoding/content-length) is confirmed working via UI. rca of the issue: n/a — no critical bug reproduced. The earlier P0 UI-login failure (proxy gzip mismatch) is fixed and login now redirects to /dashboard as expected.
